about: The tools crypto-research-mcp listed through the MCP proxy in lab 39 (2026-10-15, the evidence file mcp-tools-live.txt), each with the one-line note packages/policy/tests/fixtures/crypto-research-mcp-tools.json keeps on what it does, standing in for the server's description. The lab measured the full specs offered to MAIN at 67,303 characters of names, descriptions and schemas.

tools.name: attack-catalog-mcp_find_applicable_attacks
tools.description: Read-only lexical-overlap lookup of reference leads in the catalog.

tools.name: attack-catalog-mcp_get_attack
tools.description: Returns one attack record by catalog ID.

tools.name: attack-catalog-mcp_get_catalog_info
tools.description: Describes the loaded snapshot, refresh limits and reading guides; informational only.

tools.name: attack-catalog-mcp_get_filter_contract
tools.description: Explains filter semantics; documentation lookup.

tools.name: attack-catalog-mcp_get_source
tools.description: Returns source metadata and digest; does not fetch or verify a paper.

tools.name: attack-catalog-mcp_list_attacks_for_skill
tools.description: Paginated listing of attack references for a skill ID.

tools.name: attack-catalog-mcp_list_taxonomy
tools.description: Lists taxonomy dimensions and terms.

tools.name: attack-catalog-mcp_search_attacks
tools.description: Searches the loaded catalog snapshot with normalized filters.

tools.name: attack-catalog-mcp_search_by_legacy_value_exact
tools.description: Exact literal match on a legacy field for debugging/export parity; read-only lookup.

tools.name: e-print-mcp_corpus_stats
tools.description: Reports corpus size, year coverage and last harvest time.

tools.name: e-print-mcp_eprint_file
tools.description: Signed URL for the original; a missing original is fetched into the server cache or queued for a fetcher.

tools.name: e-print-mcp_eprint_fulltext
tools.description: Reads paper text from cache; first call downloads and caches the PDF or queues it (fetch defaults true).

tools.name: e-print-mcp_get_eprint
tools.description: Returns metadata and abstract for one ePrint paper.

tools.name: e-print-mcp_recent_eprint
tools.description: Lists the newest ePrint submissions.

tools.name: e-print-mcp_refresh_eprint
tools.description: Incrementally refreshes the whole local corpus and rebuilds its index; may be slow.

tools.name: e-print-mcp_search_eprint
tools.description: Keyword/FTS search of the ePrint corpus; read-only.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_agent
tools.description: Starts an async multi-source research job (minutes) and returns a job ID.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_agent_status
tools.description: Polls progress or result of an existing agent job.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_check_crawl_status
tools.description: Reads crawl job state; description says it does not start or modify the crawl.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_crawl
tools.description: Starts a multi-page crawl job; webhooks and interactive actions exist unless safe mode is on.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_developer_search
tools.description: Searches an index of GitHub issues, PRs, READMEs and docs; no cost or side effect stated.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_extract
tools.description: Deprecated multi-URL extraction entry point (optional web search); cost and side effects not described.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_feedback
tools.description: Submits quality feedback for a completed search, scrape, parse or map job.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_interact
tools.description: Live browser session (click, fill fields, run code); form submission can have persistent external effects.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_interact_stop
tools.description: Stops a live interact session and releases its resources.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_map
tools.description: Lists indexed URLs for a site without fetching page content; no cost stated.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_monitor_check
tools.description: Retrieves one existing monitor check and its page diffs; despite the name it does not run a check.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_monitor_checks
tools.description: Lists historical checks for a monitor.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_monitor_create
tools.description: Creates a recurring monitor that schedules future network checks and can email or call webhooks.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_monitor_get
tools.description: Reads one monitor's config and state; description says it does not run or modify it.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_monitor_list
tools.description: Lists the account's monitors.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_monitor_run
tools.description: Queues an immediate monitor check, starting network work.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_monitor_update
tools.description: Patches a monitor's schedule, targets, status, webhook or notifications.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_parse
tools.description: Parses a server-local file via Firecrawl; hosted flow uploads it; cost and retention not stated.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_research_inspect_paper
tools.description: Retrieves metadata for one paper ID.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_research_read_paper
tools.description: Retrieves relevant passages from one indexed paper.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_research_related_papers
tools.description: Finds citation-graph candidates for seed papers.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_research_search_github
tools.description: Searches indexed public GitHub issues, PRs and READMEs.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_research_search_papers
tools.description: Searches paper metadata and abstracts in the indexed corpus.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_scrape
tools.description: Single-URL scrape; warns browser actions may change the live page when interactive actions are enabled.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_search
tools.description: Search returning usage metadata; sibling feedback tool can refund 1 credit, so calls consume credits.

tools.name: firecrawl-mcp_firecrawl_search_feedback
tools.description: Records feedback on a prior search; first feedback can refund 1 credit.

tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_browse_catalogs
tools.description: Browses structured NIST catalogs and their children.

tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_get_catalog_item
tools.description: Returns one catalog item with relations and mappings.

tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_get_corpus_status
tools.description: Reports corpus coverage and nightly refresh status.

tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_get_pdf
tools.description: Returns a signed URL, official NIST URL and SHA-256 for an already archived PDF.

tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_get_publication
tools.description: Describes one publication edition and its links.

tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_list_topics
tools.description: Lists CSRC topics with counts.

tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_read
tools.description: Reads 1-10 pages of a publication as Markdown.

tools.name: nist-csrc-mcp_nist_search
tools.description: Searches NIST publications, catalog items and passages.

tools.name: paper-search-mcp_arxiv_search
tools.description: Searches arXiv preprints.

tools.name: paper-search-mcp_crossref_search
tools.description: Searches the Crossref DOI registry.

tools.name: paper-search-mcp_dblp_search
tools.description: Searches the DBLP bibliography.

tools.name: paper-search-mcp_openalex_search
tools.description: Searches OpenAlex works.

tools.name: paper-search-mcp_paper_citations
tools.description: Lists citing or referenced papers via OpenAlex.

tools.name: paper-search-mcp_paper_details
tools.description: Returns full metadata for one paper from OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, Crossref or arXiv.

tools.name: paper-search-mcp_paper_search_health
tools.description: Reports configured sources and request counters.

tools.name: paper-search-mcp_scholar_search
tools.description: Google Scholar via Serper; each call is billed (identical calls cached for an hour).

tools.name: paper-search-mcp_search_papers
tools.description: Multi-source search; default sources include Serper-backed Scholar, billed per call; own billing not stated.

tools.name: paper-search-mcp_semantic_scholar_search
tools.description: Searches Semantic Scholar.

tools.name: patent-search-mcp_patent_search
tools.description: Google Patents via Serper; each call is billed (identical calls cached for an hour).

tools.name: patent-search-mcp_patent_search_health
tools.description: Reports whether Serper is configured plus request/cache counters.

tools.name: portal_list_servers
tools.description: Lists upstream MCP servers and their enabled status.

tools.name: portal_toggle_servers
tools.description: Opens a flow where the user enables or disables upstream MCP servers; changes portal config.

tools.name: portal_toggle_single_server
tools.description: Enables (warm-up, may need OAuth) or disables one upstream MCP server.

tools.name: web-fetch-mcp_fetch_continue
tools.description: Reads the next chunk of an already cached page; no new upstream request.

tools.name: web-fetch-mcp_fetch_links
tools.description: Fetches a page and returns its links.

tools.name: web-fetch-mcp_fetch_page
tools.description: Alias of web_fetch; fetches page content.

tools.name: web-fetch-mcp_web_capture
tools.description: Screenshots a page in Firefox and returns signed PNG links; scrolls but does not interact.

tools.name: web-fetch-mcp_web_fetch
tools.description: Fetches a page via fallback engines (direct HTTP, Obscura, Firefox, Bright Data); billing not stated.

tools.name: web-fetch-mcp_web_fetch_health
tools.description: Reports available fetch engines and server config.
